select sum(num) from consumable_stock_detail a inner join consumable_reduce_record b on a.stock_id = b.id where a.stock_flag = 'REDUCE' and a.consumable_id=#{consumableId}
and b.status = ('PASS')
and b.status in ('PASS','APPLYING')
and b.claimant = #{claimant} and b.reduce_date like CONCAT('%',#{reduceDate},'%')

select * from consumable where status ='NO_DELETE'
and category_id = #{param.categoryId}
and stock > stock_max
and stock < stock_min
and (name like CONCAT('%',#{param.keyword},'%') or code like CONCAT('%',#{param.keyword},'%'))
